A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''drummer''' was part of a [[Unidentified Human band|band]] with six fellow [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], that singer's band was popular on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="SWHS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Human drummer appeared in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a TV movie set in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that aired in [[1978]]. The band drummer was played by [[John Barbata]], the drummer of the real-life band [[Jefferson Starship]], who portrayed a fictional band in the TV special.<ref name="SWHS" />
